artifacts.summary: Locates the per-phase Verification-Tier loop in validate-artifact.sh as the site for a new Files-to-modify presence check, measures the active-vs-archived population gap (1/16 active plans missing it), confirms backfill-file-scope.sh cannot fix #410 without first repairing its plan (Territory Contract table, not per-phase blocks), and documents a live legitimate empty-block case in task #750's plan.

memory_candidates.content: validate-artifact.sh's plan mode already has a reusable per-phase iteration pattern (phase_line_nums/phase_block/phase_num via extract_phase_number) built for the Verification Tier check (lines ~298-328); any new per-phase REQUIRED-field check should extend that same loop rather than adding a second file scan.

plan-file-scope-harvest.sh deliberately returns [] identically for 'no Files to modify block' and 'block present but empty (e.g. a none-planned sentinel)' -- this is documented as intentional in its own header. A live legitimate instance of the empty-but-present case exists in specs/750_w_run_layer_closure_wide_lift's plan. Any future enforcement distinguishing the two cases belongs in validate-artifact.sh, not in the harvester, to avoid rippling into the harvester's seven callers.

scripts/backfill-file-scope.sh exists and reuses plan-file-scope-harvest.sh for one-shot file_scope backfill across a repo's state.json, but it skips any task whose plan harvests to [] (treating 'no harvestable content' the same as 'no plan at all'). It cannot repair a task whose plan uses a narrative Territory Contract table instead of per-phase Files-to-modify blocks without the plan itself being repaired first.
